# Setup a mock local source directory
mkdir mock-source/skill1
mkdir mock-source/skill2

-- mock-source/axen.json --
{
  "axen_version": "1",
  "name": "mock-source",
  "skills": {
    "skill1": { "path": "skill1" },
    "skill2": { "path": "skill2" }
  }
}
-- mock-source/skill1/SKILL.md --
# Skill 1
-- mock-source/skill2/SKILL.md --
# Skill 2

# Add the local source
exec axen source add ./mock-source

# Verify source was added to lockfile
exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.axen/sources.json
grep 'mock-source' $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.axen/sources.json

# Install skill1
exec axen install mock-source --skills skill1 --targets claude

# Verify skill1 was installed correctly
exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill1
exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill1/SKILL.md
! exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill2

# List skills to verify output
exec axen list
stdout '1 namespace\(s\), 1 skill\(s\) tracked'
stdout 'skill1'

# Remove skill1
exec axen remove mock-source --skills skill1 --exclude

# Verify skill1 was physically removed
! exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill1
